s00034.summary: Captain Holloway and his crew plan a Thursday sailing in a rainy shipyard loft.
Vane, Petherbridge and Finch spar over the insured cargo; cabin boy Jeremiah asks what it is.
Holloway says only tea, but hints of Lisbon and a darker cargo; Finch worries.

s01553.summary: Coach berates her team for being fourteen down and watching the wrong thing.
Rookie Dee bursts in and reveals the opponent's tell: a dropping left shoulder.
Coach and Jazz resolve to hit the tell in the second half.

s01185.summary: Sadie meets a stranger at the drive-in, who has brought a hulking friend with a tire iron.
Detective Ortega steps out ordering hands up, and a brawl erupts amid gunfire.
The stranger gives a name, then turns the tables as his truck roars to life.

s01593.summary: Teddy finds something in a ledger and Ezekiel watches her over his newspaper.
She photographs the page; Ezekiel probes her about the ledger's age and clerk.
Teddy asks Miriam who else has requested the ledger and learns it went out four times.
Teddy returns the ledger and leaves; Ezekiel requests the same page and photographs it.

s02421.summary: Roller derby teammates banter about skating the rival jammer into the wall.
Announcer Gus asks for name pronunciations and is chased out by the coach.
Wanda tells scared rookie Delphine she is jamming; the coach lays out the plan.
Whistle blows and the team puts hands in, letting trembling Delphine call the cheer.

s00320.summary: Insurance assessor Odalys presses Bram about an unexplained fire in a sealed cellar.
Hester interjects, revealing she holds the burned logbook naming a drowned boy.
Bram smashes the teapot as the secret of the cellar comes out.

s01937.summary: Dr. Abiodun finds patient Bernadette in the MRI suite at night and questions her.
Pressed, Theodore admits she has fourteen to sixteen months and calls himself a coward.
Bernadette takes it calmly and asks him to sit and listen to the machine's hum.

s00256.summary: Detective Kaspar coolly questions Olga about a poisoned man she knew.
He crosses the cabin, strips her glove and finds a bruise of fingertips.
Olga tears free and they grapple, ending pinned on the bunk with a hairpin at his ribs.
Kaspar's wife Laura interrupts and Olga laughs, calling it a different kind of poisoning.

s00146.summary: Notary Beatrix stamps documents as Henry and son-in-law Dante prepare to sign.
Henry names Dante trustee for his grandchildren, and Dante hesitantly accepts.
Henry reads the final page slowly and signs; Beatrix stamps it and pours coffee.

s00626.summary: Stranded in the desert, Imogen braids a map-strip bracelet for Callum as water runs low.
Callum offers her the last of the water; she pushes it back.
Imogen notices water dripping from the truck and finds the spare jug empty.

s00707.summary: Vince counts cash in the laundry's back room while others work in silence.
Vince asks who was supposed to lock up and Moe and Dolly give conflicting answers.
Vince notes Nadia keeps watching the door as the front bell chimes.

s00945.summary: An unattended NICU phone rings out as Dr. Philomena returns and replays the message.
She checks the incubators, finds a baby staring at her and then an empty one.
A warm bracelet marked with her name appears, monitors flatline and all incubators stand empty.

s01003.summary: Three explorers wade through a flooded crypt as Nola insists there were four.
The water ripples unnaturally, the stairs vanish and Penny's name appears on the wall.
The lanterns go out one by one.

s01606.summary: Faith, Walt, June and the Drifter shelter in a cellar of jarred peaches.
The Drifter shows a jar with something alive inside and names himself Ephraim, hinting at what Walt keeps.

s01004.summary: Library volunteers Winifred and Leopold find a note in a returned book.
A stranger named Caspian, who leaves a note every Tuesday, arrives, followed by Agnes through the chute.
Strict librarian Muriel enters, sends the lovers out and demands who encouraged them.
Muriel finds a second note in the Dostoevsky and smiles, agreeing to next Tuesday.

s01253.summary: Doctor Mercedes serves tea to a dying woman's three grown children.
Mercedes explains their mother's bright spell is likely a final rally; days remain.
They ask for the garden and radio; Mercedes grants everything they ask.
The siblings leave, and Mercedes alone fits a puzzle piece into place.

s00564.summary: Roscoe and Phoebe, alone on a bus, learn he volunteered to stay with her.
They count the passing train cars together as she leans against him.
Their hands interlace as the count climbs until the last car passes.

s01099_1.summary: Gideon stands tensely at the lectern in a packed appellate courtroom and begins his argument.
Philomena interrupts Gideon's opening to correct how he addresses the court.

s01760.summary: Rival florists Aurelio and Beatrix collide over a bucket of ranunculus.
His grandmother phones and Beatrix tucks a flower behind his ear.
They split the stems and learn their weddings are at the same hour.

s02026.summary: Agent Renata checks a duffel of cash and passports as footsteps climb the stairs.
Elias and Deputy Hannah arrive; Renata and Elias eye the bag.
Renata and Elias brawl over the bag while Hannah tries to aim.
A siren and Dr. Amara's arrival halt the fight; Renata sits and offers her wrists.

s01515.summary: A transplant team runs final checks on a donor-heart cooler on a rooftop helipad.
The team boards while Seraphina quietly thanks the donor as the sun rises.

s00462.summary: At a ballroom dance, Nell and the captain trade glances while her aunt chaperones.
Julian crosses the floor and asks Nell for a dance, which Beatrice allows.
Drunk Lord Percival crashes in shouting for Eleanor, bottle in hand, scattering stewards.
Julian shields Nell; she steps forward and orders Percival to put down the bottle.
Beatrice leads Percival away and Nell takes Julian's hand to resume dancing.

s00674.summary: A caller through the intercom presses Professor Hartwig about his assistant's disappearance.
Cora enters, says Daniel Calloway was her brother, and traps Hartwig with a slip of her name.
Hartwig shows a ledger confession naming the old director and admits his fear.

s00688.summary: Estranged siblings and their father argue over the diner being put up for sale.
Bea restrains Yusuf, who sits; Lenny pours coffee for all.

s00926.summary: Isadora and Kofi hear a cease-fire order over the radio and cannot yet believe it.
Isadora slowly puts on her socks and asks for a minute before answering.

s00258.summary: Hester and Amara share a fire; Hester guardedly asks about her writing and destination.
Hester tells how her husband rode to Redwater and never returned.
Amara insists on going along; Hester laughs and they settle in as a whistle sounds.

s01271.summary: Lieutenant Farquhar joins soldiers in a bell tower under threat from enemy tanks.
Shells hit and they drop flat as the radio is dead and ammo is short.
A shell rings the bell and panicking Li is steadied by Halasz with grim humor.
Basco finds an unknown radio signal; as a shell hits they take positions and wait.
